extracted.name: Cheesy Potato Soup
extracted.description: This creamy, cheesy potato soup is made from scratch in one pot with cubed potatoes, broth, milk, and melty cheese for a comforting home-cooked meal.
ingredient_lines: 15 slices American cheese - broken into pieces
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onions and celery in hot butter until tender, 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir in water and potatoes. Bring to a boil and simmer until potatoes are tender. Add cheese and stir until melted.
Stir milk and flour together in a medium bowl until flour is mostly dissolved; pour slowly into soup, stirring constantly. Cook until soup is thickened, about 5 minutes.
Portion soup into bowls and garnish with parsley to serve.
